test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'GINGER' is coded as LZCKGF and 'GARLIC' is coded as WDHOYF. How will 'CLOVES' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'GINGER' is coded as LZCKGF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/736a7c0561d3ac61ec16aa43e1e3a3364ca83e33735a14932e5b2821eb8fba11.png] 

and

'GARLIC' is coded as WDHOYF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f46a6bc8cf663e9454a31b1a0de507d4c96dab521a5226bb430ee2a51ea1a11a.png] 

Similarly,

'CLOVES' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e001d99ac0abf68378d1d69639d927d27c5989974390419841f547ac2755f5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MZRLJB".**
